[SWS_CM_00062] Data accumulation on a RequiredSomeipServiceInstance in case of Signal-Based IEEE1722 ACF network binding
⌈
If a received Signal-Based IEEE1722 ACF message contains several CAN
and/or LIN frames (IEEE1722TpAcfCanPart or IEEE1722TpAcfLinPart respec-
tively), then each contained frame (IEEE1722TpAcfBusPart) shall be processed in-
dividually by the receiving Signal-Based IEEE1722 ACF network binding. Which
individual CAN and LIN frames are involved in a specific signal-service-translation is
defined by [TPS_MANI_03683].
⌋
